liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Mississippi Half-Step Uptown Toodeloo**: back after 34 archived shows (791 days) [8]
- **Minglewood Blues**: back after 80 archived shows (1180 days); rare: 11 archived performances [8]
- **When I Paint My Masterpiece**: back after 25 archived shows (667 days) [8]

## The recordings

- **deadco2021-09-03.XfinityCenterMansfiledMA4017s** (recommended): audience recording; 18 songs; 181 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **deadco2021-09-03.XfinityCenterMansfiledMANak700s**: audience recording; 18 songs; 180 min [2]
- **DeadCo2021-09-03.travitz.litz.schoepsCMC64v.flac24**: source not stated; 18 songs; 181 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [3]
- **dac2021-09-03.akgck63.v3.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 181 min [4]

## Around the show

- Sugaree here finishes strongly, whereas the 8-21-21 version faltered near the end [7]
- The 8-21-21 Morning Dew is magnificent and ranks among Dead & Co.'s best, per the reviewer [7]
- At the 8-21 show, Sugaree had a promising jam that fizzled out [7]

## Tapers and lineage

- **deadco2021-09-03.XfinityCenterMansfiledMA4017s**: taped by JT/NY John T; transferred by JT/NY; source: Aud > DPA 4017's > GakCables > Sound Devices 722 @ 24/96 [1]. Also: Edited and tracked in Sound Forge Pro 13, then converted to FLAC with Traders Little Helper [1]
- **deadco2021-09-03.XfinityCenterMansfiledMANak700s**: taped by JT/NY; transferred by JT/NY; source: Aud > Nak 700's with 701's > GakCables > Lunatec V3 > GakCables > Sound Devices 722 @ 24/96 [2]. Also: Taper was in Section 6 behind the board, with mics about ten feet high; Tracked and edited in Sound Forge Pro 13, then converted to FLAC using Traders Little Helper [2]
- **DeadCo2021-09-03.travitz.litz.schoepsCMC64v.flac24**: taped by Jeff Travitz; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Schoeps CMC64v's>Grace Design Lunatec V3>Sound Devices 744t [3]. Also: Fades in Sound Forge Pro 15, tracked in CDWAV, FLAC made with Trader's Little Helper, tagged in Foobar2000 [3]
- **dac2021-09-03.akgck63.v3.flac16**: taped by Bob Crupi; transferred by Bob Crupi; source: AKGck63(dina)/Nbob actives/Naiant pfa's->V3(24/48)->V3->Tascam DR680 [4]
